page.title: Settings
page.summaryReal: platform configuration — read-only, set at boot

apps.note: read-only · the registry is declared in the client's git
apps.emptyFiltered: no apps match the current filters

rules.note: read-only · rules live in the client's git and change by commit
rules.conflicts: No conflicts found · {{count}} active rules · scopes don't overlap.
rules.emptyFiltered: no rules match the current filters

autonomy.note: what's auto · what needs a human
autonomy.emptyFiltered: no change classes match the current filters

routing.emptyFiltered: no roles match the current filters
routing.escalation: Escalation policy — 2 failed retries on worker escalate to lead. A red type gate goes to a debug agent with a pinned revision.

budgets.readingNote: what the swarm has spent today against the global cap
budgets.killHint: Hard-stop all new claims — every app, every task.
budgets.pauseHint: Soft pause — running workers finish; no new containers start.
budgets.stopFailureTail: Nothing moved — the stops are as they were.
budgets.killBody: New claims stop now — every app, every task — and stay stopped until the switch is turned back off. Workers mid-step finish what they are holding; nothing queued is cancelled.
budgets.capsNote: the global cap the meter reads · per-task and per-app refine it
budgets.globalCapHint: The meter above measures spend against this cap.

keys.note: read-only · keys come from env, rotation runs in the proxy
keys.emptyFiltered: no keys match the current filters
keys.empty: the proxy holds no provider key

tracker.notice: A connected tracker syncs its tickets into the backlog · manual intake stays open either way.
tracker.emptyDescription: Nothing is syncing tickets into the backlog. Manual intake is open either way — a tracker only adds a second door.

platform.hint: Read-only — every value here is configured at boot. Changes go through configuration and a restart; nothing on this page writes.
platform.escalationOff: off — the ratchet is disabled ({{would}} would apply)

orchestration.leaseTtlNote: handed out on claim, extended by heartbeat
orchestration.reapGraceNote: buffer past expiry before the reaper acts
orchestration.maxAttemptsNote: claims before a stalled item fails
orchestration.escalationTimeoutNote: how long a run may sit escalated before auto-archival

compute.idleTtlNote: before a worker is a reaper candidate

proxy.passthroughNote: whether the proxy is composed at all
